text:
sara: nightly e2e perf gate failed on mixedseq-throughput. p95 up ~28%, p99 sporadic 504s. saw a couple workers hit high GC and CPU.
mike: looking now — job: https://jenkins.redwood/job/e2e-nightly/4567
ci-bot: Jenkins job #4567 failed: stage 'perf-gates' -> mixedseq-throughput (threshold breach). Artifacts: /artifacts/4567/mixedseq-logs.tar.gz
sara: logs attached show repeated kv cache evictions around the same commit range. small snippet:
```
2026-03-16T23:10:12Z runtime] WARN kv_cache: evict shard=5 entries=1024 reason=memory_pressure
2026-03-16T23:10:12Z runtime] INFO batcher: flush=64ms size=8
2026-03-16T23:10:14Z runtime] ERROR request: id=abcd timeout=504
```
anjali: can someone kick a rerun on that commit range? want to check flakiness vs regression
mike: I suspect the recent batching window tweak (commit ae3f9b2) + new kernel selection could cause micro-thrashing under mixed seq lengths. filing a bisect request.
dave: +1 for bisect. If it's kernel selection, we should be able to repro by running the perf harness locally with --workload=mixedseq --no-cache
marina: @ci-bot can you rerun job #4567 with labels "bisect-candidate" and keep artifacts? also enable diag logs
ci-bot: Rerun requested by marina for job #4567 -> started as job #4568. Labels: [bisect-candidate], diag=true
sara: thanks. if bisect fails, plan B: temporarily pin batching.window_ms to 50 and roll canary to see if gate stabilizes.
mike: I'll prepare a quick PR to pin window and add a perf test that simulates varied context lengths. pinging reviewers.
anjali: heads-up to oncall: if bisect runs show consistent kernel mismatch, we may need a short infra rollback to avoid customer regressions
mike: local repro steps I used:
```
./scripts/perf-run --model=redwood-v1 --workload=mixedseq --seq-dist=uniform(32,512) --concurrency=32 --duration=3m
```
marina: CI job #4568 finished (ci-bot): preliminary shows p95 back to baseline but p99 still jittery. saving artifacts. attaching link: /artifacts/4568/
sara: good interim. please leave bisect running and update this thread with commit suspected if found. thanks :thumbsup:
